ex.en: A timely snow promises a good harvest.
ex.zh: 瑞雪兆豐年。

ex.en: Thank you for your timely reply.
ex.zh: 謝謝你及時回覆。

ex.en: We need timely information to make decisions.
ex.zh: 我們需要及時的資訊來做決定。

ex.en: Is the timer running?
ex.zh: 計時器有在跑嗎？

ex.en: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.
ex.zh: 電腦內部計時器的鈕扣電池沒電了。

ex.en: Set the timer for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 把計時器設定為十分鐘。

ex.en: How many tiles do you need?
ex.zh: 你需要幾塊磁磚？

ex.en: The bathroom floor is covered with white tiles.
ex.zh: 浴室地板鋪著白色磁磚。

ex.en: We had the kitchen floor tiled last month.
ex.zh: 我們上個月請人把廚房地板鋪了磁磚。

ex.en: They tiled the walls in blue.
ex.zh: 他們用藍色磁磚貼牆。

ex.en: Now all you have to do is tighten the screw, and Bob's your uncle.
ex.zh: 現在你只要把螺絲鎖緊就大功告成了。

ex.en: Please tighten your seat belt.
ex.zh: 請繫緊安全帶。

tighten.zh: 加強、收緊（規定、控制）；tighten one's belt 節省開支

ex.en: Critics are coming down hard on tightened economic restrictions.
ex.zh: 收緊經濟管制的措施遭到批評者猛烈抨擊。

ex.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
ex.zh: 小型企業必須勒緊褲帶才能生存。

ex.en: The airport has tightened security.
ex.zh: 機場加強了安檢。

ex.en: Our service offers three pricing tiers.
ex.zh: 我們的服務提供三種價格方案等級。

ex.en: Customers in the top tier get free shipping.
ex.zh: 最高等級的會員享有免運費。

ex.en: The wedding cake had three tiers.
ex.zh: 那個結婚蛋糕有三層。

ex.en: The stadium has two tiers of seats.
ex.zh: 這座體育場有上下兩層座位。

ex.en: There is a shortage of good construction timber right now.
ex.zh: 目前缺乏優質的建築用木材。

ex.en: The house is built of timber.
ex.zh: 這棟房子是木造的。

ex.en: The tide is coming in.
ex.zh: 正在漲潮。

ex.en: You can walk to the island at low tide.
ex.zh: 退潮時可以走路到那座島。

ex.en: The tide of public opinion is turning.
ex.zh: 輿論風向正在轉變。

ex.en: It's hard to swim against the tide.
ex.zh: 要逆勢而行很難。

tide.zh: tide (sb) over：幫（某人）度過難關、撐過一段時間

ex.en: Can you lend me $100 to tide me over?
ex.zh: 你能借我一百塊，讓我撐過這陣子嗎？

ex.en: This snack will tide you over until dinner.
ex.zh: 這份點心可以讓你撐到晚餐。

ex.en: Please tick the box if you want to receive our newsletter.
ex.zh: 如果想收到我們的電子報，請勾選此方塊。

ex.en: Tick all the options that apply.
ex.zh: 勾選所有符合的選項。

ex.en: Put a tick next to the correct answer.
ex.zh: 在正確答案旁邊打勾。

ex.en: I put a tick next to each completed task.
ex.zh: 我在每一項完成的工作旁邊打了勾。

ex.en: The only sound to be heard was the ticking of the clock.
ex.zh: 唯一聽得到的聲音是時鐘的滴答聲。

ex.en: Time ticks by more slowly around a black hole.
ex.zh: 黑洞附近的時間流逝得比較慢。

tick.zh: what makes (sb/sth) tick：（某人）的想法動機；（某物）的運作原理

ex.en: I like to take things apart to see what makes them tick.
ex.zh: 我喜歡把東西拆開，看看它們是怎麼運作的。

ex.en: I'd love to know what makes him tick.
ex.zh: 我很想知道他腦子裡在想什麼。

ex.en: I don't have time to cook tonight.
ex.zh: 我今晚沒時間煮飯。

ex.en: Time flies when you're busy.
ex.zh: 忙的時候時間過得特別快。

time.zh: 時刻、時候（幾點；該…的時候）

ex.en: It's time for you to buy a new car.
ex.zh: 你該買一輛新車了。

ex.en: What time is it?
ex.zh: 現在幾點？

ex.en: I've been to Japan three times.
ex.zh: 我去過日本三次。

ex.en: This is my first time here.
ex.zh: 這是我第一次來這裡。

ex.en: The deer is three times as heavy as Jane.
ex.zh: 那隻鹿是簡的三倍重。

ex.en: This river is three times longer than that one.
ex.zh: 這條河是那條河的三倍長。

ex.en: Please be on time for the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會請準時。

ex.en: We arrived just in time for the show.
ex.zh: 我們剛好及時趕上表演。

ex.en: What is the title of your new book?
ex.zh: 你新書的書名是什麼？

ex.en: What is the title of the book?
ex.zh: 這本書的書名是什麼？

ex.en: The novel takes its title from the Bible.
ex.zh: 這本小說的書名出自《聖經》。

ex.en: What is your job title at the company?
ex.zh: 你在公司的職稱是什麼？

ex.en: She was given the title of senior manager.
ex.zh: 她被授予資深經理的頭銜。

ex.en: The team won the national title last year.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍去年拿下全國冠軍。

ex.en: He has held the world title for three years.
ex.zh: 他已經保持世界冠軍頭銜三年了。

ex.en: The rear tire of my bicycle is flat.
ex.zh: 我腳踏車的後輪沒氣了。

ex.en: Take a look at these tires.
ex.zh: 看看這些輪胎。

ex.en: I had a flat tire on the way to work.
ex.zh: 我上班途中爆胎了。

ex.en: You work too hard these days. Aren't you tired?
ex.zh: 你這幾天工作太賣力了，不累嗎？

ex.en: Long meetings really tire me out.
ex.zh: 冗長的會議真的讓我筋疲力盡。

tire.zh: be tired of / tire of：厭倦

ex.en: I'm tired of eating fast food every day.
ex.zh: 我厭倦了每天吃速食。

ex.en: She never tires of hearing that song.
ex.zh: 那首歌她百聽不厭。

ex.en: This shirt doesn't go with that tie at all.
ex.zh: 這件襯衫跟那條領帶一點都不搭。

ex.en: Can you show me how to tie a tie?
ex.zh: 你能教我怎麼打領帶嗎？

ex.en: The boat was tied with a short line.
ex.zh: 船用一條短繩綁著。

ex.en: She wore a ribbon tied around her hair.
ex.zh: 她頭髮上綁了一條緞帶。

ex.en: The two nations have strong trade ties.
ex.zh: 這兩國有密切的貿易關係。

ex.en: The company has close ties with local universities.
ex.zh: 這家公司和本地大學關係密切。

ex.en: The match ended in a tie.
ex.zh: 比賽以平手收場。

ex.en: The vote was a tie, so we voted again.
ex.zh: 投票結果同票，所以我們重新投票。

ex.en: We carried on the discussion till late at night.
ex.zh: 我們一直討論到深夜。

ex.en: I lived in the US from 2008 till 2011.
ex.zh: 我從 2008 年到 2011 年住在美國。

ex.en: Did you stay till the end of the concert?
ex.zh: 你一直待到演唱會結束嗎？

ex.en: You never know what you can do till you try.
ex.zh: 不試試看，你永遠不知道自己能做什麼。

ex.en: Please wait here till I come back.
ex.zh: 請在這裡等我回來。

ex.en: The cashier put the money in the till.
ex.zh: 收銀員把錢放進收銀機。

ex.en: There was only 500 dollars in the till.
ex.zh: 收銀機裡只有五百元。

ex.en: He came from a tiny mountain town.
ex.zh: 他來自一個小山城。

ex.en: Add a tiny pinch of salt.
ex.zh: 加一小撮鹽。

ex.en: It's a tiny country that most people have never heard of.
ex.zh: 那是一個大多數人都沒聽過的小國。

ex.en: These shoes are too tight. They hurt.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋太緊了，穿了腳痛。

ex.en: These jeans are too tight for me.
ex.zh: 這件牛仔褲我穿太緊了。

ex.en: We are traveling on a tight budget.
ex.zh: 我們旅行的預算很緊。

ex.en: We are on a tight schedule this week.
ex.zh: 我們這週的行程很緊湊。

ex.en: Hold on tight to the handrail.
ex.zh: 抓緊扶手。

ex.en: Close the lid tight after use.
ex.zh: 使用後請把蓋子蓋緊。

ex.en: I think I'm gonna sneeze. Give me a tissue.
ex.zh: 我好像要打噴嚏了，給我一張面紙。

ex.en: Do you have a tissue? I have a runny nose.
ex.zh: 你有面紙嗎？我在流鼻水。

ex.en: Human tissue is made up of cells.
ex.zh: 人體組織是由細胞構成的。

ex.en: The doctor removed a small piece of tissue for testing.
ex.zh: 醫生取了一小塊組織去檢驗。

ex.en: We do not accept tips.
ex.zh: 本店不收小費。

ex.en: We left a 15% tip for the waiter.
ex.zh: 我們給服務生 15% 的小費。

ex.en: You'd better remember that tipping is necessary in the USA.
ex.zh: 你最好記住，在美國一定要給小費。

ex.en: There is no tipping culture in China.
ex.zh: 中國沒有給小費的文化。

ex.en: I'll keep the tips you shared for improving my presentation skills.
ex.zh: 你分享的提升簡報技巧的建議，我會記下來。

ex.en: Here are some tips for learning English.
ex.zh: 以下是一些學英文的訣竅。

ex.en: It's on the tip of my tongue.
ex.zh: 話就在嘴邊，可是想不起來。

ex.en: The tip of the pencil broke.
ex.zh: 鉛筆的筆尖斷了。

ex.en: I admit, I'm not the tidiest person in the world.
ex.zh: 我承認我不是世界上最愛整潔的人。

ex.en: Please keep your desk tidy.
ex.zh: 請保持桌面整齊。

ex.en: My room is a tip. I need to tidy it.
ex.zh: 我的房間亂七八糟，得整理一下。

ex.en: We will tidy up our room so that Mom is satisfied.
ex.zh: 我們會把房間整理好，讓媽媽滿意。

ex.en: New York and Taipei are in different time zones.
ex.zh: 紐約和台北在不同的時區。

ex.en: It's hard to schedule meetings across time zones.
ex.zh: 跨時區安排會議很不容易。

ex.en: I'd like two one-way tickets from A to B.
ex.zh: 麻煩給我兩張從 A 到 B 的單程票。

ex.en: The concert ticket costs more than the cinema ticket.
ex.zh: 演唱會門票比電影票貴。

ex.en: Can I pick my ticket up at the airport?
ex.zh: 我可以在機場取票嗎？

ex.en: I got a parking ticket yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天被開了一張違規停車罰單。

ex.en: He got a speeding ticket on the highway.
ex.zh: 他在高速公路上被開了超速罰單。

ex.en: Is there a timetable?
ex.zh: 有時刻表嗎？

ex.en: According to the timetable, the next train leaves at 9:15.
ex.zh: 根據時刻表，下一班火車 9 點 15 分開。

ex.en: What's the timeline for the new website?
ex.zh: 新網站的時程是怎麼安排的？

ex.en: The timeline is too tight to finish everything.
ex.zh: 時程太緊了，沒辦法全部做完。
